versions.changelog: update the description in SETUP.md, advise ai agent to directly create the .env file by itself.

- Initial release of supabase-query skill for Windows.
- Enables querying Supabase databases via REST API using project ID and anon key.
- Supports only read (SELECT) operations for security.
- No need for database drivers; works through HTTP and returns JSON results.
- Limits results to 200 rows per query and enforces a 30-second timeout.
- Credentials managed locally via .env file for safety.
